title: Edge of the Sea | 5BR Vacation Home by Rosemary Beach | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Edge of the Sea is a 5BR Gulf view home near Rosemary Beach 30A with private pool and deeded beach access just steps away. Reserve with Royal Destinations!
description_expanded: Description: Edge of the Sea by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 124 Geoff Wilder Lane Details: Edge of the Sea is located in the exclusive Gulf-front Water's Edge community! This fabulous beach house boasts a private pool, Gulf views, and decks or porches off every bedroom. This home has a wonderful design to accommodate multiple families including (2) king suites with private bathrooms. The finishes in this home are beautiful including the hardwood floors, solid surface counter-tops and stainless appliances. Water's Edge is a beach-side neighborhood bordering Rosemary Beach and has a private deeded beach access. This great location is also directly across from The Villages of South Walton’s shops, boutiques, and entertainment and just 3 blocks from Alys Beach! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 25 feet -Coffee Maker Available -Propane Grill -Private Heated Pool *Pool Heat is available for an additional $280 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 13 5 Beds / 4.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with Shared Hallway Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 2: Bunkroom with Full/Twin bunk beds -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Bathroom (Tub/Shower Combo) -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 4: King En Suite, walk-in shower, double vanity, walk-in closet, furnished porch -Half Bath -Full sleeper sofa in Living Room Third Floor: -Bedroom 5: (Grande Suite) King Bed, large walk in shower, double vanity, walk-in closet, private balcony with Gulf views Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -Gated Community -Walking Distance to Rosemary Beach -1 Beach Service Set* *Seasonal: March – November Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
